After analyzing email performance data from 847 SaaS companies, we finally have a data-driven answer to the ActiveCampaign vs Mailchimp question.

The headline finding: ActiveCampaign users see 34% higher conversion rates on average. But that's not the full story.

ActiveCampaign dominates when you need:
→ Complex automation workflows
→ Advanced behavioral triggers
→ Sophisticated lead scoring
→ Multi-touch attribution

Mailchimp remains the better choice when you:
→ Have under 5,000 subscribers
→ Value simplicity over sophistication
→ Need faster team onboarding
→ Want predictable, lower-tier pricing

The worst decision? Choosing based on brand recognition rather than your actual automation needs and team size.
